let loopValue: number = 0;
for ([loopValue] of [["bad"]]) console.log(loopValue);
for ({x: loopValue} of [{x: "bad"}]) console.log(loopValue);
const fixedValue = 1;
for ([fixedValue] of [[2]]) console.log(fixedValue);
const unknownValue: unknown = 42;
for (const key in unknownValue) console.log(key);
